trigger: trimcrae, 2026-08-26: 'Isn't there supposed to be rules about using subagents and starting new sessions to keep context from inflating? I know I asked for it. But that guard failed based on what I'm seeing in this thread. Please fix that issue.'

root_cause.finding: THE RULE WAS UNREACHABLE, NOT UNHEEDED — which is a different bug and needs a different fix. It lived only in .claude/skills/research-loop/SKILL.md §3. A skill binds only when it is loaded. Every one of that skill's four load triggers was a Routine firing a cycle, so on the INTERACTIVE path — a human asking for research work directly — the skill never loaded and §3 never applied.
root_cause.discriminating_observation: '"name":"Skill"' appears 0 times in the offending session's transcript (/root/.claude/projects/-home-user-Rare-cancers/66dab3ca-….jsonl), while that session ran CYC-0005 and CYC-0006 end to end. Had the count been non-zero the diagnosis would have been non-compliance and the fix a stronger rule; it is zero, so the fix is reachability.
root_cause.measured_cost: 23 compaction markers and a 7.6 MB transcript in one session; two cycles in this one and three in session_011zRMmQKPj7ziG3gY9yhpBQ.
root_cause.second_cause: Even when loaded, §3 was unenforced prose. None of health.py's conditions measured it, no test in systems/tests/ guarded it, priority.py had no session_id handling. The claim lease and the stall alarm each carry a suite and a workflow; §3 carried nothing. A rule with no gate behind it decays into a suggestion.
root_cause.a_violation_of_the_rule_s_own_terms: §3 also says ⛔ THE DRIVER NEVER WAITS — dispatch, record, end the turn. This session held turns open waiting for both blind seats to land, and said so in as many words. That spends the driver's context on waiting instead of on the verdict, which is the whole reason a seat is a subagent.

the_fix_has_three_layers_because_one_wou.1_reachability: CLAUDE.md — which loads EVERY session, interactive included — gains a §6 tripwire row pointing at research-loop §3, and a fifth always-fires rule stating the spawn case and 'the driver never waits' directly. The skill's description now names the interactive path as a load trigger.
the_fix_has_three_layers_because_one_wou.2_enforcement: health.py gains a ninth condition, `cycles_are_sized`, reading receipts' session_id against autonomy-state.json's new `max_cycles_per_session` (2). Unstamped receipts are UNMEASURED, never counted as fresh sessions — otherwise the cheapest way to green the row would be to stop stamping receipts.
the_fix_has_three_layers_because_one_wou.3_guards: Nine tests on the condition plus a reachability test asserting CLAUDE.md carries the rule text and the skill's description names the interactive path. Both halves mutation-tested: un-wiring the condition turns 3 tests red, deleting the rule from CLAUDE.md turns 1 red.

honest_limit_of_the_fix: ⚠ IT BOUNDS CYCLES, WHICH IS A PROXY FOR CONTEXT AND NOT CONTEXT ITSELF. One enormous single cycle passes this check. Nothing in this repository can read a context window, and receipts already carry session_id, so this is the measurement that EXISTS rather than the one that would be ideal. An imperfect gate that fires beats a perfect one that does not. Stated here rather than discovered by the next seat.
